entries.title: FinCEN publishes a readout of a FinCEN Exchange event on transnational scam centers attended by digital asset industry partners
entries.facts: FinCEN published a readout dated November 9, 2026 of a FinCEN Exchange event on combating illicit financial activity associated with transnational scam centers. The readout states that the event brought together representatives from financial institutions, digital asset industry partners, law enforcement agencies, and other government partners, and that participants shared information on the financial activities of scam center operations. The readout announces no new rule, advisory, obligation or deadline. It refers institutions to FinCEN materials issued in August 2026 - an Alert and a Financial Trend Analysis on digital asset investment scams - states that institutions should be vigilant and review them, and cites Executive Order 14390.
entries.source_label: FinCEN news release, "READOUT: FinCEN Hosts Exchange Event to Combat Overseas Scam Centers," November 9, 2026
entries.relevant_to: digital asset exchanges and custodians, banks, money services businesses, payment processors
